issues.description: The PersonService.savePerson method has inconsistent visibility between template and solution and is used from PersonResource in the solution. In the template PersonService.savePerson is declared public, which matches the intended design where REST resources forward requests to the service. In the solution PersonService.savePerson is declared private but PersonResource still calls personService.savePerson(...). This visibility mismatch is a structural error: the service method is not accessible to the REST controller when private, causing compilation errors and confusing students about how to wire Resource -> Service calls.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore consistent visibility for savePerson so the REST resource can call it. Make savePerson public (as in the template) or otherwise expose a public method on PersonService for creating/updating persons; then ensure PersonResource uses that public API. This preserves the intended Resource -> Service layering and compiles correctly.
